clips.title: The story
paras: At Mor'shan Rampart, the Horde guards the northern end of the Gold Road and the way into Ashenvale. The Warsong clan built the barricade to shield Horde territory from night elf counterattacks and stage raids into the forest.

Mor'shan Rampart guards the northern end of the Gold Road, where the Barrens meet Ashenvale. Its timber walls and watchtowers were raised against night elf strikes over the Horde's logging. From here, raiding parties head north toward Astranaar.

Warsong fighters and sentries keep Mor'shan Rampart ready for battle. They watch the tree line for night elf scouts and archers, while the post keeps supply lines open between Ashenvale's frontline outposts and Horde settlements to the south.
